policy.method: Independent Fraction and itertools for n<=8; math.comb for n>8; normal math.erfc
policy.binomial: Integer n=0..30, k=-1..31; impossible k has mass 0; n=0 has mass 1 at k=0
policy.percentages: Finite numbers in [0,100], at most two decimals; Fraction(str(p))/100
policy.pmf: Array indexed by k=0..n; p=0 and p=100 include all degenerate boundaries
policy.uniform: Finite numeric endpoints with at most two decimals; bounded support [a,b], a<b, lower<=upper
policy.density: Uniform density on support is 1/(b-a); single points have probability zero
policy.normal: Finite mean and interval endpoints, positive finite sigma, lower<=upper; erfc CDF and survival differences in positive tails
